metadata.boundary: Retrospective FAA ATCSCC advisory extraction only; no live operational use.

cq_evaluations.metric: primary type coverage plus advisory-number property metrics
cq_evaluations.gap: Per-system primary-class accuracy is not yet scored as a first-class metric.
cq_evaluations.layer: S0, S1b, S2, S3, S4, validator

cq_evaluations.metric: role-aware controlled-element precision/recall/F1 and profile-gap rate
cq_evaluations.gap: ARTCC controlled-element facts remain profile gaps until a reviewed bridge exists.
cq_evaluations.layer: S0 parser, entity canonicalizer, S2/S4 enrichment, validator

cq_evaluations.metric: normalized-time precision/recall/F1 and fabricated-time false positives
cq_evaluations.gap: The report can score exact values but does not yet isolate rollover-specific errors.
cq_evaluations.layer: S0 time normalizer, S1b canonicalizer, S2/S3/S4

cq_evaluations.metric: status/action predicate F1 and active-overclaim false positives
cq_evaluations.gap: Status labels are sparse, so comments evidence remains important context.
Some source-supported causes remain outside the current controlled vocabulary.
cq_evaluations.layer: S2/S3/S4 enrichment, enum canonicalizer, gold review

cq_evaluations.metric: reroute predicate-family F1 and constrained-element F1
cq_evaluations.gap: AFP/CTOP semantics remain deferred unless the profile and sample support them.

cq_evaluations.metric: schema violation rate, repair success, and required-core-field coverage
cq_evaluations.gap: Schema conformance is separate from semantic support and must not be treated as truth.

cq_evaluations.metric: type-specific violation rate and profile-gap count
cq_evaluations.gap: Accepted profile extensions require reviewed ontology/profile changes.

cq_evaluations.metric: evidence containment coverage for accepted and reviewed missing facts
cq_evaluations.gap: The current contract stores evidence text, not stable character offsets.

cq_evaluations.metric: semantic precision, unsupported-triple rate, and rejected-fact adjudication counts
cq_evaluations.gap: Value-support judgement remains a reviewed semantic metric, not pure SHACL validation.
cq_evaluations.layer: gold review, adversarial validator review, S4 diagnostics

cq_evaluations.metric: query-field coverage now; answer-set precision/recall after query materialization
cq_evaluations.gap: Template graph queries over the frozen KG are not yet materialized as a scored artifact.
cq_evaluations.layer: graph materialization, graph query, later GraphRAG layer

cq_evaluations.metric: absent-field false positives and abstention correctness
cq_evaluations.gap: The gold set exposes false positives, but explicit absent-field labels need a follow-up pass.

next_steps: Add primary-class accuracy scoring for CQ-D01 instead of relying on class coverage.
Materialize frozen-snapshot template queries for CQ-Q01 and score answer-set precision/recall.
Add explicit absent-field labels or derived negative examples for CQ-A01 abstention correctness.
Keep ARTCC controlled-element profile gaps separate from accepted facts until a reviewed bridge exists.
